en.text: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.

zhSimplified.text: 列国啊，要近前来听！ 众民哪，要侧耳而听！ 地和其上所充满的， 世界和其中一切所出的都应当听！

zhTraditional.text: 列國啊，要近前來聽！ 眾民哪，要側耳而聽！ 地和其上所充滿的， 世界和其中一切所出的都應當聽！

en.text: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华向万国发忿恨， 向他们的全军发烈怒， 将他们灭尽，交出他们受杀戮。

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華向萬國發忿恨， 向他們的全軍發烈怒， 將他們滅盡，交出他們受殺戮。

en.text: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.

zhSimplified.text: 被杀的必然抛弃， 尸首臭气上腾； 诸山被他们的血融化。

zhTraditional.text: 被殺的必然拋棄， 屍首臭氣上騰； 諸山被他們的血融化。

en.text: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

zhSimplified.text: 天上的万象都要消没； 天被卷起，好像书卷。 其上的万象要残败， 像葡萄树的叶子残败， 又像无花果树的叶子残败一样。

zhTraditional.text: 天上的萬象都要消沒； 天被捲起，好像書卷。 其上的萬象要殘敗， 像葡萄樹的葉子殘敗， 又像無花果樹的葉子殘敗一樣。

en.text: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我的刀在天上已经喝足； 这刀必临到以东和我所咒诅的民， 要施行审判。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我的刀在天上已經喝足； 這刀必臨到以東和我所咒詛的民， 要施行審判。

en.text: The LORD’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的刀满了血， 用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血， 并公绵羊腰子的脂油滋润的； 因为耶和华在波斯拉有献祭的事， 在以东地大行杀戮。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的刀滿了血， 用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血， 並公綿羊腰子的脂油滋潤的； 因為耶和華在波斯拉有獻祭的事， 在以東地大行殺戮。

en.text: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

zhSimplified.text: 野牛、牛犊，和公牛要一同下来。 他们的地喝醉了血； 他们的尘土因脂油肥润。

zhTraditional.text: 野牛、牛犢，和公牛要一同下來。 他們的地喝醉了血； 他們的塵土因脂油肥潤。

en.text: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

zhSimplified.text: 因耶和华有报仇之日， 为锡安的争辩有报应之年。

zhTraditional.text: 因耶和華有報仇之日， 為錫安的爭辯有報應之年。

en.text: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.

zhSimplified.text: 以东的河水要变为石油， 尘埃要变为硫磺； 地土成为烧着的石油，

zhTraditional.text: 以東的河水要變為石油， 塵埃要變為硫磺； 地土成為燒着的石油，

en.text: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 昼夜总不熄灭， 烟气永远上腾， 必世世代代成为荒废， 永永远远无人经过。

zhTraditional.text: 晝夜總不熄滅， 煙氣永遠上騰， 必世世代代成為荒廢， 永永遠遠無人經過。

en.text: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

zhSimplified.text: 鹈鹕、箭猪却要得为业； 猫头鹰、乌鸦要住在其间。 耶和华必将空虚的准绳， 混沌的线铊，拉在其上。

zhTraditional.text: 鵜鶘、箭豬卻要得為業； 貓頭鷹、烏鴉要住在其間。 耶和華必將空虛的準繩， 混沌的線鉈，拉在其上。

en.text: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 以东人要召贵胄来治国； 那里却无一个， 首领也都归于无有。

zhTraditional.text: 以東人要召貴冑來治國； 那裏卻無一個， 首領也都歸於無有。

en.text: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

zhSimplified.text: 以东的宫殿要长荆棘； 保障要长蒺藜和刺草； 要作野狗的住处， 鸵鸟的居所。

zhTraditional.text: 以東的宮殿要長荊棘； 保障要長蒺藜和刺草； 要作野狗的住處， 鴕鳥的居所。

en.text: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

footnotes.text: 34:14 literally, lilith, which could also be a night demon or night monster

zhSimplified.text: 旷野的走兽要和豺狼相遇； 野山羊要与伴偶对叫。 夜间的怪物必在那里栖身， 自找安歇之处。

zhTraditional.text: 曠野的走獸要和豺狼相遇； 野山羊要與伴偶對叫。 夜間的怪物必在那裏棲身， 自找安歇之處。

en.text: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

zhSimplified.text: 箭蛇要在那里做窝， 下蛋，抱蛋，生子， 聚子在其影下； 鹞鹰各与伴偶聚集在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 箭蛇要在那裏做窩， 下蛋，菢蛋，生子， 聚子在其影下； 鷂鷹各與伴偶聚集在那裏。

en.text: Search in the book of the LORD, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要查考宣读耶和华的书。 这都无一缺少， 无一没有伴偶； 因为我的口已经吩咐， 他的灵将它们聚集。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要查考宣讀耶和華的書。 這都無一缺少， 無一沒有伴偶； 因為我的口已經吩咐， 他的靈將牠們聚集。

en.text: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

zhSimplified.text: 他也为它们拈阄， 又亲手用准绳给它们分地； 它们必永得为业， 世世代代住在其间。

zhTraditional.text: 他也為牠們拈鬮， 又親手用準繩給牠們分地； 牠們必永得為業， 世世代代住在其間。
